text:
Predicates:
Allowed(x) ::: Pets are allowed in x.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: x is a managed building.
DepositRequired(x) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in x.
SecurityDeposit(x, y) ::: The security deposit in x is y.
Rent(x, y) ::: The monthly rent at x is y.
Cat(x) ::: x is a cat.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
ApartmentRentedBy(tom, x) ::: Tom rents an apartment in x.
MoveInAllowed(tom, x, y) ::: Tom is allowed to move in with y in x.
MoreThan(x, y) ::: x is more than y.
NoMoreThan(x, y) ::: x is no more than y.
Fluffy ::: Fluffy.
Tom ::: Tom.
OliveGarden ::: The Olive Garden.
Premises:
∃x (ManagedBuilding(x) ∧ Allowed(x)) ::: Pets are allowed in some managed buildings.
∀x (ManagedBuilding(x) → DepositRequired(x)) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in a managed building.
∀x ∀y (SecurityDeposit(x, y) → (y = Rent(x) ∨ y > Rent(x))) ::: The security deposit can be either equal to one month's rent or more.
Cat(fluffy) ∧ Pet(fluffy) ∧ Fluffy = fluffy ∧ Tom = tom ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat. Cats are pets.
ManagedBuilding(oliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building.
Rent(oliveGarden, 2000) ::: The monthly rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
ApartmentRentedBy(tom, x) ↔ (Allowed(x) ∧ MoveInAllowed(tom, x, fluffy) ∧ NoMoreThan(SecurityDeposit(x, d), 1500)) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if and only if he is allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500.
MoreThan(2000, 1500) ::: 2000$ is more than $1500.
Conclusion:
(SecurityDeposit(oliveGarden, 2000) ∨ ∃y (y > 2000 ∧ SecurityDeposit(oliveGarden, y))) ::: The security deposit at the Olive Garden is either $2000 or more.
